source.label: Illustrative developer exercise, NOT an independently supplied teacher question
source.question: A free nonrelativistic test mass moves in a fixed prescribed uniform downward gravitational field of 2 m/s^2. With initial position (1,2,0) m and velocity (0.4,1.2,0.1) m/s, what are its position and velocity after 2 seconds? Report the field at the launch point and its initial and final total mechanical energy using zero gravitational potential at the origin.

givens: Initial position (1,2,0) m and velocity (0.4,1.2,0.1) m/s
Test mass 2.5 kg, duration 2 seconds, potential reference origin (0,0,0) m
assumptions: Static prescribed field, nonrelativistic independent test mass
No collisions, drag, source backreaction or other forces
illustrative_choices: 21 saved samples on a uniform 0.1 second grid
